posts.title: Authenticated Doesn't Mean Authorized
bullets: A valid token identifies the caller, not which records they may access.
Test with two accounts: change a resource ID to one owned by another user.
Verify that unauthorized reads, updates, and deletes are denied.
posts.takeaway: Enforce object-level access on every request.
posts.caption: A valid token proves who called the API—not whether they may access that record. Test object-level authorization with two accounts, swap resource IDs, and verify that unauthorized reads and writes are denied. #APISecurity #AppSec #OWASP #DevSecOps Save this for later.
